headline: Everything you write now shows up everywhere, right away.

highlights.title: Your tasks, in sync everywhere
highlights.body: Tasks from your Today page, brain dump and voice now reach Tasks and Insights reliably, even after a while away.

highlights.title: A widget that matches your day
highlights.body: The home-screen ring now counts exactly what's on your Today page, and shows your next unfinished task.

highlights.title: Opens straight into your day
highlights.body: No more sign-in prompts while ALIBI wakes up. Your tasks are there instantly and sync in the background.
